streams.pump_role: Single feed stream containing all reagents
streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan specifies single stream. Concentration 0.1 M from Engineering Calculations Step 1. Flow rate 0.5 mL/min derived from target residence time and reactor volume.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan states all reagents combined in batch; simultaneous mixing in flow is appropriate. Single stream eliminates need for complex mixing order.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas DMF solution via sparging with inert gas (N2 or Ar) prior to pumping to remove dissolved oxygen, as Pd catalyst is oxygen-sensitive (Chemistry Plan).
post_reactor_steps: Collect product stream. No quench required per Chemistry Plan.
chemistry_notes: Thermal Suzuki-Miyaura coupling. Microwave heating in batch translates to thermal heating in flow. No light source required. Single stream simplifies setup. Oxygen sensitivity requires degassing. Engineering calculations indicate mass-transfer limitation (Da=70), suggesting efficient mixing is critical, though single stream pre-mixing mitigates inter-stream mixing issues. Axial dispersion (Pe=7) is significant but acceptable for first screen.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Engineering Calculation Step 2 suggests 0.6 min. Analogy 1 used 12 min but was photochemical/SET. Analogy 2/3 were photochemical. Thermal Suzuki couplings are typically fast. 0.6 min is conservative for 50C. Note: With 5mL reactor and 0.5 mL/min flow, actual tau is 10 min. To achieve 0.6 min, flow rate would need to be ~8.3 mL/min, which exceeds pump max (5.0 mL/min). Therefore, we use the smallest available reactor volume (5mL) and highest feasible flow rate (5.0 mL/min) to minimize residence time, resulting in tau = 1.0 min. This is within the calculated range [0.3-1.0] min.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: 50 C from Batch Protocol and Chemistry Plan. Within PFA max temp (80 C).
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Engineering Calculation Step 8: BPR not required. DMF bp (153 C) >> 50 C.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA from Inventory. Suitable for 50 C and DMF.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Adjusted to 5.0 mL/min (max pump capacity) to minimize residence time in the 5 mL reactor, achieving tau = 1.0 min. This is the closest achievable value to the target 0.6 min given inventory constraints.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: 5 mL from Inventory. Smallest available to minimize residence time.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: Empty. Reaction is thermal, not photochemical.
reasoning_per_field.deoxygenation_method: Sparging. Required by Chemistry Plan due to Pd sensitivity.
